title: Brooklyn courtyard residence
design_brief: A three-story Brooklyn residence with warm brick, bronze window frames, limestone entry steps and a landscaped courtyard. Late-afternoon light.

scenes.visual: Street-level wide view of the brick facade, showing the limestone entrance and planted setback.
scenes.narration: A thoughtful addition to the neighborhood, shaped by warm materials and generous daylight.

scenes.visual: View across the landscaped courtyard toward the residence, with native planting and a small seating area.
scenes.narration: A sheltered courtyard creates a quiet place to gather, connecting the home to the outdoors.
